Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Vinod - 34 years, son
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
2. Meenakshi - 60 years, mother
Look: green saree

Places

1. The main road - a wide road, traffic lights
2. The road - a paved road, trees along it

Scene 1: The main road - Day

[Vinod stands on the road. Meenakshi stands near him.]

Meenakshi: "Vinod, what's the plan today?"

[Vinod starts the car, turns the steering wheel and drives off.]

Meenakshi: "Vinod, look at this."

[Vinod is driving when he slams on the brakes.]

Meenakshi: "This is amazing!"

[Vinod steps on the accelerator and speeds away in his car.]

Vinod: "Hmm, I see."

[Vinod's bike skids on the wet road and he falls off.]

Meenakshi: "And then?"

[A dog runs in front of Vinod's car; he brakes hard and swerves just in time.]

Vinod: "That's easy."

[Vinod loses his balance on the bicycle and falls.]

Vinod: "Yes, all right."

[Vinod waits at the zebra crossing and then crosses the road.]

Vinod (laughing): "And then?"

Scene 2: The road - Day

Vinod: "Mom, look over here."

[Vinod rides his motorbike to the market.]

Vinod: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Vinod starts his scooter and rides off.]

Vinod: "Hey, look at that!"

[Vinod drives the car to the office.]

Vinod: "Okay, Mom."

[Vinod gets out of the car.]

Meenakshi (happily): "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
